title: Learning Metastable Dynamics
abstract: arXiv:2609.14712v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Metastability---a phenomenon where systems remain trapped in quasi-stable states before abruptly transitioning under rare perturbations---is ubiquitous in physical systems. Although metastability is a widely observed phenomenon, its identification and analysis present significant challenges. To address these challenges, we propose a novel framework for analyzing metastability using Koopman theory. We use a finite set of system trajectories to learn a representation of the dynamics that defines a latent space in which the system evolves linearly, thereby enabling a systematic characterization of metastable behavior through the spectral properties of the linear mapping. Empirical evaluations demonstrate that our approach is capable of anticipating metastable behavior significantly earlier than its actual manifestation, even with $10\%$ of the simulation duration. translated_abstract: 亚稳态——即系统在被罕见扰动触发而突然转变之前，长期停留在准稳定状态的一种现象——在物理系统中普遍存在。尽管亚稳态是被广泛观察到的现象，但对其的识别和分析仍面临重大挑战。为应对这些挑战，我们提出了一种基于Koopman理论分析亚稳态的新颖框架。我们利用有限的系统轨迹集合来学习动力学的一种表示，该表示定义了一个潜空间，系统在该空间中线性演化，从而能够通过线性映射的谱性质对亚稳态行为进行系统化的刻画。实证评估表明，我们的方法能够在亚稳态行为实际显现之前显著更早地对其进行预判，即使仅使用仿真时长的10%。此外，我们证明了所学习的Koopman算子的主导特征值（摘要在此处截断）。
tldr: 本文提出基于Koopman理论的新框架，通过学习潜空间中的线性动力学表示及其谱性质来刻画亚稳态行为，能够仅用10%的仿真时长就远早于实际显现预测出亚稳态行为。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a novel Koopman-theory-based framework that learns a latent linear representation of system dynamics, enabling anticipation of metastable behavior significantly earlier than its actual manifestation—even with only 10% of the simulation duration.
